verdict.rationale: Kushki documents recurring and scheduled charges (cargos recurrentes, cargos calendarizados) and webhooks, but the only webhooks shown are for card-present payments. Nothing in the pack covers failed-payment notifications, automated retries, or dunning outreach, so these adjacent features earn no credit. An agent-driven failed-payment recovery workflow is a fair axis for a payments platform with subscriptions, so the verdict is none rather than na.
